extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Text on Accent row under Skin Settings, Overall, beside Custom Accent Colour. Left on White, every screen looks as before. Set to Auto, the text on a focused row or button, a selected list row and the badge pills turns dark when the accent is light: Amber, Orange, or a custom colour that is light, so a yellow accent stays readable. Text on the skin's dark panels is not touched.
